notes: Fixes licence activation on most Macs. Crisp was checking the licence server’s identity against a list of trusted authorities that only exists on Macs with developer tools installed, so on everyone else’s Mac activation failed with a message about your internet connection even though the connection was fine. Crisp now brings its own list. The same fix makes the built-in update check and the Max quality download work on those Macs too. If you bought Crisp and could not activate it, this build fixes that — and if it still does not, email support@crispvideo.app and we will sort it out.
